PLAN "12-Week Post-MI Moderate Fitness Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve general fitness and functional strength while maintaining moderate intensity"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Full body steady session":
        warmup:
          walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_rhythm_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing_cable_hip_extension 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          light_stationary_cycle 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper focus + aerobic":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pull_down 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          single_arm_dumbbell_row 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          band_face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Lower focus + balance":
        warmup:
          stationary_cycle 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat_box 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise_seated 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          gentle_stretch 5m
